description: This file contains unit tests for the AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It specifically tests API endpoints related to punch out record overlaps in the attendance module, including setup routines, data providers for test cases, and methods to verify API behaviors and unimplemented operations.
